title_en: SBPAC joins forces with U.I. – UNICEF to drive 5-year-old child nutrition plan aimed at sustainable solution of malnutrition in southern border provinces
summary_en: Today (November 25, 2569) at the C. Or Sor volunteer Pattani Hotel in Mueang District of Pattani Province, Ms. Piyuvarn Juesguol, Assistant Secretary of Southern Frontier Administration Centre (SFAC), chaired the opening ceremony for a workshop on preparing an integrated five-year (2571–2575) operational plan for early childhood nutrition in Pattani province.
